result.document_summary: A City of Los Angeles Housing Department web page with a rent increase calculator for units under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), stating the 3% annual allowable increase for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026 and the RSO/SCEP surcharge pass-throughs.
result.notes: The page states the annual allowable increase applicable July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 (3%); it is the only rate stated and it may not be the rate for the current query period (2026-10-01). The page does not state the underlying ordinance citation, the RSO's original effective date, or building-age/unit coverage tests, so coverage is left empty; the page only says to check ZIMAS to see whether a unit is RSO. The state 30-day notice mention is a notice detail, not a separate in-scope rule, and is included in the interaction text. Pass-through surcharge amounts are treated as details of the RSO instrument.

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For units subject to the RSO, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. Since February 2, 2026 landlords can no longer add any extra percentage for utilities, and RSO ($1.61/month) and SCEP ($2.83/month) surcharges may be passed through only after the units are registered and written notice is given.
rules.key_value: 3% annual allowable increase (July 1, 2025 - June 30, 2026); no additional utility percentage after Feb 2, 2026
rules.quoted_span:

rules.coverage_text: Rental units in the City of Los Angeles that are subject to the Rent Stabilization Ordinance; the page directs users to ZIMAS to determine whether a unit is an RSO unit.
rules.interaction: State law requires 30 days' written advance notice for rent increases of less than 10%. Non-RSO properties are directed to the Housing Department for information on allowable increases.
